errors.evidence: The figure shows the starting value in 2008 for graph A is approximately 270 days, not 280.
The figure shows a value of approximately 240 days in 2017 for graph A, not 245.
The y-axis label in graph A is 'Средни леглодни (дни)', not 'Средни петгодни (дни)'.
The y-axis range in graph B is from 0% to over 2%, not 1.0 to 2.0.
The figure shows the starting value in 2008 for graph B is approximately 1.6%, not 1.5%.
The figure shows values below 0.6% in 2012 and 0.3% in 2013 for graph B, not 1.0%.
The figure shows a value of approximately 1.0% in 2017 for graph B, not 1.3%.
The figure shows a value of approximately 2.8% in 2021 for graph B, not 2.1%.

The description does not explicitly state what the charts represent: Figure A illustrates the change in average length of stay, and Figure B illustrates the structural effect on average length of stay as a percentage change.
The description omits the exact tick intervals on the y-axis for graph A (labels every 20 days) and graph B (labels every 0.5%).
The description does not mention the presence of black markers on the red line for both graphs.
The description does not specify the lowest point in graph B (0.3% in 2013).
The phrase oversimplifies the distinct purposes of each graph without clarifying what each trend represents.
